provenance.method: Generated for structcorpus from the published yamlprims specification revision 1.3, sections 4, 5.1, and 8.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Integer and float resolution for sign, base, range, overflow, underflow, non-finite, and binary32-threshold texts in plain, quoted, and tagged forms. Revision 2 adds typed-conversion expectations (DDR-0005). Bound to the revision 1.3 profile; expectations are identical to the revision 1.1 recipe because no input in this set is affected by 1.2/E-1 to E-3 or 1.3/E-1 to E-4.
